bioghist.head: Biographical/Historical Information
bioghist.p: The Board for Opticians was established in 1954 to regulate individuals who fit and sell prescription glasses and contact lenses. The Board licenses persons practicing or offering to practice as opticians in the Commonwealth. The Dept. of Professional and Occupational Regulation provides administrative support to the board. In 2012, the Board was merged with the Board for Hearing Aid Specialists to create the Board for Hearing Aid Specialists and Opticians.

odd.p: These records are part of the Virginia Dept. of Professional and Occupational Regulation record group (R.G.# 17)

Electronic records in this collection are read-only and are only available in the Archives Research Room at the Library of Virginia. A file list is available through the online catalog entry and the link below in the finding aid. Copies are free of charge and may be requested while using the collection in-house. Copies may also be requested by contacting Archives Reference Services. Processing will take from 4-8 weeks.

scopecontent.p: Minutes and related attachments documenting the meetings, activities, discussions, policy decisions, and recommendations of the Virginia Board for Opticians. Includes official board minutes, as well as draft minutes, committee meeting minutes, agendas and other meeting materials. May also include informal fact finding hearing minutes, correspondence, guidelines, legislation, regulations and reports.

Electronic records often contain board meeting packets with various attachments and draft minutes, while paper records often include minutes only. There may be some duplication between paper and electronic records. For transfers prior to 2012, records of individual boards were accessioned separately. After this, transfers of records (records starting in 2008) included all boards, which were accessioned under one accession number. There is a separate finding aid for the later transfers (link to finding aid below).

Board minutes and board meeting packets, 2006, are in electronic format (1.84 mb, 11 files, 2 folders; format: pdf). Includes agendas, draft minutes, examination statistical reports and quarterly board reports. For file inventory for this accession, see: Inventory (44998).
Minutes, 2008, are in paper format. Folders are included in a box with minutes from other DPOR boards. For guide for this accession, see: Finding aid (45436).

Minutes, 2008, are in electronic format. Minutes, 2009-2010, are in paper format. Folders are included in a box with minutes from other DPOR boards. For guide for this accession, see: Finding aid (51228).
Minutes, 2011-2012, are in paper format. Folders are included in a box with minutes from other DPOR boards. For guide for this accession, see: Finding aid (51966).
